name: NIH ChestX-ray14 and the RSNA pneumonia subset
what: 112,120 frontal chest films of 30,805 patients; the RSNA pneumonia detection challenge on Kaggle used 30,000 of them
level_truth: none; the frontal thoracic spine behind the mediastinum
status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; open (NIH) and Kaggle competition rules (RSNA); volume with no agreement, no laterals
licence: open (NIH); Kaggle competition rules for the RSNA subset
how_to_get: Open https://nihcc.app.box.com/v/ChestXray-NIHCC and read the archive list and its batch download script.
Fetch as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py http-get --url U --dest FILE for each archive address the page gives.

The RSNA subset (https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/rsna-pneumonia-detection-challenge) needs a Kaggle account and the competition rules accepted by the owner; the Kaggle API token comes from the submitter's environment, never from this repository.
